messages:
zhao: Quick async — kicking off slice handshake for S74 ramp at 08:00 UTC. Posting what I did / blockers / today. please ping if you need me to hold the ramp.
andrea: What I did: updated the rollout script to include KV cache warmup, ran local dry-run for 50 reqs. Blockers: one heatmap job still failing in staging, unclear root cause. Today: monitor first 5 slices after ramp, standready for rollback. :eyes:
sam: Heads up - feature flag `s74_ramp_v2` is toggled to 2% on staging. Can we confirm targeting rules? I see `region:eu` and `tier:beta` only. @zhao is global needed?
maria: Quick data point from canary: 95p latency +0.5% on gen tokens when holding > 8k context. Error rate stable. I ran 1k sample requests: success 99.6%, avg latency 210ms, p95 480ms. Putting numbers here so PMs have them.
andrea: @maria thanks. If p95 climbs above 600ms we abort. Also added a safety throttle: `--max-inflight=1200` in the rollout script.
zhao: Agree on abort threshold. Current plan: start 1% -> 3% -> 10% over 30m windows, validate metrics at each step. If p95 delta > +25% or error > 1%, rollback.
sam: quick ask — how are we routing fallback? Do we have automatic fallback to gpt-lite variant when mem pressure spikes?
andrea: yes, smart routing rule `fallback:compatible-variant` active. If node OOM or queue depth > 200 we flip to `gpt-small-q8` automatically. Logs route: `router->proxy->runtime` with fallback hop.
devops-bot: Deploy job #3421 started: expanding slice S74 replicas to 12 across us-east-1a/b. Build: inference-runtime:2.14. Showing progress: 3/12 pods ready.
oncall-bot: Alert (P3): Increased queue depth on runtime-prod-eu-03. Current depth 186. Triggered at 2178457020.
maria: Noted queue spike coincides with canary traffic shift 1%->3%. Might be transient. I'll keep sampling traces.
zhao: Action items: 1) @andrea watch rollout script and manual abort button, 2) @sam confirm FF targeting includes `global=true` flag if we want cross-region, 3) @maria collect traces + heap profiles for any pod crossing 150MB heap. I'll be online 08:00-09:30 UTC.
andrea: Also pushed a tiny observability tweak: added `request_id` in tail logs for easier correlation. Example: `curl -H "x-request-id: S74-<uuid>" http://internal/proxy/health`
sam: Confirmed — I'll flip `global=true` in the next small window after we see stable 10% for 10m.
maria: collecting traces now — attaching rough sample ids: tr-8a3, tr-8a4. Will upload to shared bucket in 5m.
zhao: small rollback play if needed: `/scripts/rollout --slice S74 --target 0.0 && /scripts/route --ff s74_ramp_v2 off` — this shuts slice traffic and disables FF. Keep that handy.
andrea: copy. I'll keep the abort command in slack pin. :thumbsup:
devops-bot: Deploy job #3421 progress: 8/12 pods ready. No restarts detected.
oncall-bot: Reminder: if error rate crosses 1% for >3m, page oncall. Current error rate 0.4% (1m).
zhao: closing loop: looks like green to 3% step. I'll update when we hit 10%. Thanks everyone.
andrea: good luck — ping me if you want a manual warmup on regions.
maria: uploading traces now :arrow_up:
sam: :thumbsup:
